learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn basic basketball techniques.
Students will learn basic offense and defense systems.
Students will gain the habit of playing team sports.
Students will learn and be able to apply creative plays in sports.
Students will learn through interdisciplinary teaching and cooperation, and will recognize basic principles and their application areas in sports.

syllabus_topics: Historical development of basketball, basic techniques, tactics-skills and rules of the game.

Ball handling, behind the back and change of direction, jump shot, pass stop-fake, cross-over, reverse (left right) layup, triple passing layup applications
